description: This file defines a HomeFragment class for an Android TV app, implementing a complex home screen with hero carousel, 'Continue Watching' rail, and TV channels rail. It manages focus navigation, auto-scrolling, layout spacing, and integrates Compose UI components such as TopNavBar.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing UI layout, focus navigation, hero carousel, and content rails for the Android TV home screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and repository for data fetching.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Builds the main view hierarchy, including the Compose TopNavBar and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and subscribes to ViewModel data updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scroll and refocuses as needed when returning to the fragment.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops auto-scroll and clears animations.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData from ViewModel to update UI states.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading and shows content in Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message and retries data fetch.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates continue watching rail with fetched data and sets focus routing.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV channels rail with fetched channels data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Compose-based top navigation bar with initial focus and focus delegation.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets up hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus management, peeking, and symmetric spacing.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers specified hero card in viewport, with optional animated scrolling.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling when user navigates manually.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Resumes automatic hero carousel scrolling.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops automatic hero scrolling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Constructs the 'Seguí viendo' horizontal list with loading and content views.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Constructs the TV channels horizontal list with focus routing.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus for the content rails.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to pixels.
